# Pull request

## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] I reviewed the diff for private information, credentials, tokens, keys, hostnames, addresses and runtime data.
- [ ] Documentation is updated when behaviour or operating instructions changed.
- [ ] Docker Compose changes pass `docker compose config`.
- [ ] GitHub Actions and YAML changes pass the repository quality checks.
- [ ] Markdown links and formatting are valid.

## Operational impact

Describe any deployment, upgrade, backup, networking or compatibility considerations. Write `None` if there are none.
